title: Breaking it Down: Economic Consequences of Disaggregated Cost Disclosures
near_miss_reason: Entropy-balancing weights in every treatment column: Table 3 Panel A column 1 (reghdfe profgp mcdl1 [aweight=_webal], absorb(kisnum year)) is otherwise a clean TWFE, but every column weights by ebalance weights (treated under the 5b IPW exclusion); Table 3 Panel A col 2, Panel B and Table 7 add lagged time-varying controls. Shipped data are masked fake files, so the paper cannot enter the main analysis in any case.
eligible_reason: Staggered binary design: Korean listed firms that disclosed the cost-of-sales schedule in 2003 begin withholding it (mcdl1) in firm-specific years after the rule change (masked data: first withholding 2005:48, 2006:24, 2007:16, 2008:11, 2009:13 firms; 65 never withhold), firm and year FE, clustered by industry. Every mcdl1 column uses entropy-balancing weights; Table 6 placebos (unweighted) use single-date indicators (post-2004 x high CSD2003; 2002-2004 x high CSD2001), not staggered.
design_notes: master.do runs do/MainResults/t2-t7.do and f1-f2.do. t3.do line 40: reghdfe profgp mcdl1 [aweight=_webal] if sample==1, absorb(kisnum year) vce(cluster ksicnum); line 42 adds marketshare_alll1 lsizel1 investmentl1 leveragel1 salesgrowthl1 negearningsl1; lines 86-88 add ndmc10osl1 (other cost schedules). t4.do: industry-year dispersion on industry mean NDMC (continuous). t5.do: cross-sectional determinants of withholding. t6.do: placebos. t7.do: TFP and labor productivity with controls. Published out/tables/t3a.txt (real-data run): mcdl1 = 0.0156** (0.0064) col 1, 0.0161*** (0.0055) col 2, N = 7,497. _webal is constant within firm in the masked file.
n_eligible_specs_note: Table 3 Panel A column 1 would qualify on design if entropy-balancing weights were admitted, but the data are fake.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Masked data: first withholding years 2005-2009 (48/24/16/11/13 firms), 65 never-withholders, 35 switch-backs. Real counts unknown.
